posts.title: Deal Alert November 2026
posts.description: Black Friday and Cyber Monday deals are starting. I’ll update this post as new sales are listed. IDW Publishing has most Artist’s Editions and Artisan Editions at 60% off, so a lot of $60 USD Artist’s Editions. Walt’s Comic Shop has a selection of AE format books at 30% off and 50% off.
